concerns.text: FR-005 requires Mann‑Whitney U and Kolmogorov‑Smirnov secondary analyses, but T008 only implements a Wilcoxon signed‑rank test. Add tasks (e.g., T013) to run Mann‑Whitney U and KS tests on both crash‑count and severity distributions.
SC-002 mandates a Kolmogorov‑Smirnov test on severity‑score distributions. No task currently performs this test; introduce a task (e.g., T014) to compute the KS statistic for severity scores.

SC-003 defines an effect‑size threshold (|Cliff’s Δ| > 0.14). T008’s verification only records the effect size without checking the threshold. Add a verification step (or a new task) to assert that the effect size meets the required minimum.

SC-006 requires at least 50 valid paired problem entries per LLM model after generation failures. Current tasks verify a total of 50 human problems but do not enforce the per‑model 50‑pair threshold. Add a task (e.g., T015) to validate that each model achieves the required pair count.

The implementation plan defines Phase 0 – Environment & Seed Setup, but no task in tasks.md addresses this phase (e.g., creating the deterministic Docker image, pinning seeds, verifying checksums). Add a task (e.g., T000) to cover Phase 0.
